author: Mister Letterman
content:
As an experienced player I spend my time with these types of entertainment, however after not getting a response in reasonable time I have to put this review. Based solely on my experience and my experience alone , I hope this information helps the next USER. 

Both in my personal and professional opinion I believe the platform has poor management and terrible business ethics.
In the first few levels it will seem like you have many rewards waiting however the purchase rebate will not ever become available - the platform shows a player rewards to entice purchases and give false hope, the platform removes its access prior to you be able to collect. Just the past week I spent $500.00 USD(multiple bundles from $15.00-$100.00)  for personal game play and to capture great gaming videos, and well - unfortunately I got the complete opposite and literally witness DEAD SPINS after DEAD SPINS and for whatever reason or another BUY BONUS appears and reappears when they choose so I couldn’t try that . 
my SC CREDITS Decrease rapidly and no matter what bet $0.20 -$4.00 SC I got no bonuses nor did any game give me a shot at FAIR PLAY! it would take up $10-$30 before it gave anything over my bet amount as a win . 
IMPORTANT: Support is unresponsive and wait time is extended and as of right now I have still have not been reached out to (but they will respond here, ⬇️⬇️ check how long and what they say in response to me publicly 😂)
. The MEGA REBATE is impossible to get LV 20 for $5 - purchased many different size bundles from $15-$100 and I went from LV 15 to LVL 17 and still half to LV 18 and well that’s just unreasonable. 
THIS REVIEW BASED OFF MY EXPERIENCE WITH THIS PLATFORM.
UNSURE IF I will delete because there is definitely a few upsids to this platform compared to others, REDEEMTION is 💯 instant literally on any VIP LEVEL (1-2-3-4) on LEVEL 1 I receive a payout as quickly as I did on LEVEL 4 However the processing fee is stupid crazy and is another way this platform will get their money (10%) no matter what tier VIP you are. Lastly, GC coins are free “ALWAYS FREE TO PLAY” Is a bit misleading because SC GAMES are a SWEEPSTAKES/ GIVEAWAY Platform and cannot market the games as a casino offering ways to win real money , instead they offer FREE GC that comes with FREE SC but in truth you actually pay for the SC (the loop hole) and is why I must stress this - players shouldn’t have to pay for any VIP (like a gym membership / with benefits)  GC coins will not level you up nor will you have any VIP TIER - only when you purchase. 
Level 5 is a lot of VIP POINTS AND only come in bundles so PLEASE look at the bundles and calculate how much money it take to reach that level and you will see it’s insanely expensive. 
Anyways I hope this helps any other  player in deciding if this is a great pick or if my experience helps  anyone relating to this and helps you understand this is very normal for these types of platforms .

author: Jack Parisee
title: Illegally operated scam. Beware.
content:
I got sucked into Victory Blast and ended up losing a significant amount of money. The experience  was deliberately encouraged to keep spending and gambling through promotions and gameplay that are extremely misleading. It then does NOT pay out.

I’m located in California and became concerned about whether this type of gambling is even permitted here. It is not. It operates illegally in California and was fully aware of my location. I feel like that information should have been made crystal clear to me before I ever deposited money.

When I tried to address the situation with support, I was met with a frustrating back and forth instead of any resolution. The customer service is AI. I asked for my money back and explained my concerns, but was treated like a joke.

I take responsibility for the money I spent, but this company has a responsibility to be transparent about what they’re offering, where it’s legally available, and how their promotions work.

Do not go down this rabbit hole. I wish I never did.
